value: tympanic membrane absent, tympanic annulus not visible
method: taxonomic description of the preserved holotype
conditions: Holotype CORBIDI 15769, adult male (SVL 15.6 mm), preserved; one individual. Methods: 'Specimens were preserved in 70% ethanol.' The Diagnosis item (2) words it differently: 'tympanic membrane not differentiated, tympanic annulus barely visible below skin'. The quote is the single holotype-description sentence, with one cut marked; the cut text covers head proportions, eye, snout, nostrils, lores, lips, tubercles and eyelid width and none of it qualifies this value. Anatomy only; hearing not tested.

method: taxonomic description of the preserved holotype; the paper prints the ratio in the Description of the holotype
conditions: Holotype ZSFQ-4142 (field number JCS-1613), adult female (SVL 64.9 mm), preserved; one individual. Methods: 'The specimen was euthanised with a 5% lidocaine solution, fixed in 10% formalin, and preserved in 70% ethanol, following recommendations by McDiarmid (1994) and Simmons and Muñoz Saba (2005).' The quote is the second sentence of the holotype description (the first is 'Adult female (Figs 2-4), 64.9 mm SVL, body robust.'), with two cuts marked; the cut text covers snout, nostril, interorbital and eye proportions, the supratympanic fold ('supratympatic fold prominent, extending from below eye across upper and posterior margins of tympanum towards posterior end of mouth and down to arm insertion'), the region behind the head, vomerine teeth, choanae and tongue, and none of it qualifies the tympanum value. Same clause: tympanic membrane and annulus evident. Anatomy only; hearing not tested.
